instruction: Set VS Code to hide all .vscode directories from the file explorer view.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring VS Code to hide .vscode directories (VS Code workspace settings) from file explorer. Evaluator checks settings.json for files.exclude pattern **/.vscode set to true. Uses existing check_json_settings metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to hide .vscode directories
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly retrieves VS Code settings file at /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Metric (check_json_settings) correctly checks for files.exclude pattern with **/.vscode set to true
Expected value is semantically correct: **/.vscode pattern matches all .vscode directories recursively
Data flow is correct: file path -> JSON parsing -> key-value verification
Edge cases handled: missing file (returns 0.0), malformed JSON (returns 0.0), missing keys (returns 0.0)
No postconfig needed - settings persist to disk after user changes
Complete coverage: single-step instruction is fully verified

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
